review: Runtime controls are covered well. Add an implementable loop and a distinction between cancellation, termination, and unknown external outcomes.
build: Implement a fake model/tool loop with a shared call budget, a deadline, and a durable operation identity. Force an invalid tool call and cancel during an external effect.
verify: The loop terminates within its budget, invalid calls never execute, and a timed-out write is marked unknown until reconciled rather than automatically repeated.
